q: 1. The maximum amount of advance payment (mobilization fund) permitted is ……… of contract amount.
explain: Per the answer key, the maximum is 20% of the contract amount.

q: 2. Contractor's prequalification is required for
explain: Prequalification is generally required only for major and specified/specialized works to ensure the contractor has adequate capacity and experience.

q: 3. Site order book is used for recoding
options: indents for materials to be ordered
explain: The site order book records the engineer's instructions to the contractor.

q: 4. Contractor is liable to maintain the defects upto
explain: The contractor must rectify defects during the defect liability period.

q: 5. Security deposit deducted from contractor's bill is
options: refunded when the contractor has completed the work
refunded even before the completion of the work provided good progress has been established
retained till the expected life of the structure of say 100 years and spent for maintenance
refunded when the defect liability period is over
explain: Security deposit is retained as protection against defects and is refunded only after the defect liability period expires satisfactorily.

q: 6. During the construction period, price variation clause in contracts to
options: increase in rates of only important materials
variation in cost in materials element, labour element and petrol-oil-lubricant element
variation in total cost of the project on an adhoc basis
explain: Price variation clauses compensate for cost changes across materials, labour, and fuel (POL) elements during construction, not just important materials or an adhoc total figure.

q: 7. Direct purchase can be done for construction work when the amount is
explain: Per public procurement regulations, direct purchase (without formal bidding) is permitted for works valued up to Rs. 0.3 million.

q: 8. The tender is
options: Written offer submitted by contractor to execute works
explain: A tender is the written offer submitted by a contractor proposing to execute the specified works at quoted rates/terms.

q: 9. Earnest money is a .......towards the execution of a public tender government contract.
explain: Earnest money is a deposit submitted by bidders as a guarantee of serious intent to execute the contract if awarded.

q: 10. The pre qualification criteria is approved by
explain: Per the answer key, the department head.

q: 11. Which types of tender generally prefer
explain: Schedule of Rates (SOR) is preferred in civil engineering works as it allows for payments based on actual quantities measured at agreed rates.

q: 12. While filling the tender for any work, the contractor considers quotation?
explain: A contractor must evaluate the site conditions, labor market, and technical requirements (specifications) to provide an accurate and competitive price.

q: 13. Tender is awarded for
explain: In competitive bidding, the contract is typically awarded to the lowest responsive and responsible bidder who meets all technical requirements.

q:
14. Tender is called for
i) to minimize the cost of an item
ii) to find exact rate of item of unknown item
iii) to take minimum rate from contractor
explain: Tenders invite open competition to minimize work costs and obtain competitive rates from contractors[cite: 1].

q: 15. Which of the following information is generally not published in a tender notice?
explain: Performance bond requirements are typically specified in the contract document rather than published details in the initial tender notice.

q: 16. If a contractor is found corrupt for tender work then what should be done by the concerned office
explain: Corruption leads to administrative actions like cancellation, financial penalties, and potential legal prosecution.

q: 17. Tender document does not contain
explain: The unit rates are filled in by the contractor during the bidding process; the blank document itself does not provide them.

q: 18. The purpose of bid evaluation is to determine
explain: Bid evaluation aims to identify the lowest evaluated bid among those that are substantially responsive to the tender requirements.

q: 19. The types of contract followed in Middle-Marsyangdi hydro electricity project is
explain: Major public civil engineering works like hydro projects typically utilize item rate contracts[cite: 1].

q: 20. The types of contract followed in Manmohan Memorial Polytechnic Institute (Hatimuda, Morang) is
explain: This institution complex project was awarded as a turnkey design-build construction contract[cite: 1].

q: 21. Force majeure in contract is:
options: occurrence of an act beyond the control of both the parties
preventing both parties to perform the respective obligation agreed
explain: Force majeure refers to 'Acts of God' or unforeseeable events that make contract fulfillment impossible through no fault of the parties.

q: 22. Force majeure in a contract is
options: occurrence of an event beyond the control of both the parties of the contract
occurrence of an event beyond the control of the contractor
occurrence of an event beyond the control of the employer
explain: Force majeure refers to unforeseeable events beyond the control of both contracting parties (e.g., natural disasters), excusing performance delays.

q: 23. The price of tender document for the bidding amount upto two crore is (Source:PPR2064(48))
explain: According to Nepal PPR 2064 Rule 48, standard bid document fee up to NRs 2 crore is NRs 3,000[cite: 1].

q: 24. Consulting works worth more than 10 crores NRs should be procured on the basis of
explain: Per the answer key, international-level EOI and RFP.

q: 25. If damage occurred within specified time internal, it falls on the work of
explain: During the construction and defects liability period, the contractor is responsible for damage to the works.

q: 26. The estimated cost of works must be quoted in the tender notice for works worth up to
explain: Per the answer key, up to 2 crore.

q: 27. The maximum amount for approval of tender by Gazetted 3rd class officer is (Source:PPR 2064(67))
explain: Standard delegation of authority limits a 3rd class officer to tenders below 10 Crore (100 million).

q: 28. The authority of Gazetted third officer for the approval of estimate is (Source:PPR 2064(14))
explain: Financial delegation under Nepalese PPR authorizes Gazetted 3rd class officers up to NRs 10 million[cite: 1].

q: 29. *The object of technical drawing is
explain: Drawings are essential for estimating costs, guiding construction, and procuring the correct materials.

q: 30. The amount of money deposited by successful bidder as a security for satisfactory performance is called
explain: Performance security is required from the selected bidder prior to signing the contract to ensure the satisfactory completion of the project.

q: 31. Petty contract is:
options: work entrusted to a contractor without any restrictions
contract wholly owned by a single staff
contract selected as the best one
a contract of small amount and volume to be fully handled by a staff
explain: A petty contract involves a small amount/volume of work that can be fully managed and handled by a single designated staff member.

q: 32. Amount required to be deposited by contractor while submitting tender is
explain: Earnest money is the amount a contractor deposits along with the tender submission as a guarantee of serious intent.

q: 33. Which of the following is the ultimate method of dispute resolution in any contract
explain: Court litigation is the last resort.

q: 34. A set of documents submitted by a contractor to a project office with a description of works or goods to be provided and the proposed price is known as
explain: A tender is the set of documents submitted by a contractor describing proposed works/goods and their prices.

q: 35. As per the financial regulation minimum time required for tender notice is for NCB contract:
explain: Financial regulations stipulate a minimum of 30 days for tender notice period for National Competitive Bidding (NCB) contracts.

q: 36. The bid review committee consists of ……… members of persons.
explain: Per the answer key, 3.

q: 37. Consulting works worth more than 10 crore NRS should be procured on the basis of
options: International level request for EOI and RFP
explain: For high-value consulting contracts exceeding NRS 10 crore, procurement follows an international-level Request for Proposal process.

q: 38. Relation between contractor, consultant & engineer should be
options: should not create the stage of quarreling
if any problem created, there should be mutualization for discussion
explain: Professional harmony and collaborative problem-solving between all parties are essential for project success.

q: 39. Power stations are generally treated as
explain: Power plants involve complex machinery and specific structural requirements that classify them as industrial projects.

q: 40. An offer in writing to execute some specified civil works at certain rates within a fixed time under certaion conditions of contract is called:
explain: A bid (or tender submission) is a formal written offer submitted by a contractor detailing terms, rates, and timeframe to perform specified work.

q: 41. Which of the following column is left blank in Bidding documentary by the employing agency?
explain: In Bill of Quantities (BOQ) tender documents, the employer supplies descriptions, units, and estimated quantities while leaving the unit rates blank for bidders to quote.

q: 42. An agreement between two parties or more to do or not to do any work is known as:
explain: By legal definition, a contract is an agreement enforceable by law between two or more parties creating mutual obligations.

q: 43. A written offer submitted by contractors to execute certain work at certain rates within a fixed time is called:
explain: A tender is an official written invitation response offering to perform construction works under stated rates and schedules.

q: 44. Amicable settlement means
explain: Amicable settlement refers to a dispute being resolved directly and mutually by the two contracting parties themselves, without external intervention.

q: 45. Which of the following is a primary process for procurement of goods and services from a competitive market?
explain: Bidding is the primary competitive procurement process.

q: 46. Public procurement monitoring office (PPMO) can blacklist the bidders disobeying the code of conduct upto ……… years.
explain: Per the answer key, 3 years.

q: 47. Contractor's prequalification is required for:
explain: Prequalification is required specifically for major and specialized works needing verified contractor capability.

q: 48. Maximum amount that can be paid to the contractor as a prize for the early finishing of the works is equal to ……… % of the contract amount.
explain: Per the answer key, 10%.

q: 49. As per public the public procurement regulation 2064, who approves the prequalification criteria?
explain: Per the answer key, the concerned department chief.

q: 50. While filling the tender for any work, the contractor considers
explain: A contractor considers site conditions, material availability, and labour availability while preparing a tender bid - all of the above.

q: 51. When actual cost of construction plus certain profit is paid to the contractor then such a contract is known as
explain: A cost-plus-percentage contract pays the contractor actual costs incurred plus an agreed percentage as profit.

q: 52. Which of the following is done first in procurement of consulting services
explain: The Expression of Interest (EOI) comes first, then short listing, then RFP.
